objective.objective: four-phase equal weight, bareSET three equal groups, exact original-record masks
objective.reset_initiation_coordinate: nonnegative natural-log drive amplitude, passed without log10 transformation
objective.bare_record_chronology_policy: One prepared bare SET/RESET prediction scored against all raw bare records; inter-record continuity is not assumed.
objective.timing_policy: No sampling times or waits inferred or introduced by the objective adapter.

recovery_accounting.reason: Replace relative-only finite differences, which used a 1.49e-8 perturbation for log10 kRESET=0, with explicit absolute parameter steps. No material law, objective, tolerances, or start count changed.

scope: Fixed lognormal shape and measured transistor mapping; shared material across circuits.

Prefix periodicity is a checked local numerical shortcut; final full32 audit required.
No holdout arrays loaded; all invalid trials and budget terminations retained.
